node.label: Flat nasal alae
node.definition: An abnormal degree of flatness of the Ala of nose, which can be defined as a reduced nasal elevation index (lateral depth of the nose from the tip of the nose to the insertion of the nasal ala in the cheek x 100 divided by the side-to-side breadth of the nasal alae).

evidence.snippet: Xeroderma pigmentosum: Flat nasal alae (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
